description: Cryptominium's PowerMap: which company or group holds which of nine powers over a coin (freeze, pause, mint, redeem, custody, govern, validate, pay out, bridge), each repeating that party's own terms with a link and a date, plus on-chain readings of mint and freeze authority. Answers questions about a coin ("USDC"), a company ("Circle"), or a class of coins ("which stablecoins can be frozen"), and says what is not established. It records who can use a power, not whether they will.

query.description: A coin, a company, or a question, e.g. "USDC", "Circle", "which stablecoins can be frozen".

title: PowerMap: who holds power over a coin
